text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain or loss does not by itself show whether a trade was sound; base decisions on the stock’s outlook and my original rationale, not my average cost.","A few strong months do not establish an edge, and monthly account swings are noisy; judge performance over longer periods against the market and avoid reacting to short-term moves.","Before each trade, check how it changes my overall exposure and cash cushion, and keep position sizes within risk limits rather than letting individual trades drive the portfolio."]}
